layer_1_geometric_boundary.definition: 两个 geometric span 是否在物理位置上属于同一连续文本区域
layer_1_geometric_boundary.p71_relation: P7.1 receives P4 spans as input
layer_1_geometric_boundary.p72_relation: P7.2 does not process this layer

layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.definition: 两个 span 是否属于同一个有意义的文本单元（句子、短语、标题文本）
layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.human_role: yes (Human reads text, judges semantic continuity)
layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.p4_relation: P4 does not participate (geometry-only contract forbids text analysis)
layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.p71_relation: P7.1 does not judge inter-span semantic relations
layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.p72_relation: P7.2 is the execution channel (ValidationTask → Record → Evidence)
layer_2_semantic_text_unit_boundary.amb_026_position: AMB-026 belongs here — sentence boundary requires text reading

layer_3_document_structure_boundary.definition: span 属于什么文档结构角色（heading/body/table/formula/caption/column/procedure）
layer_3_document_structure_boundary.output: HEADING / BODY / TABLE_CELL / FORMULA / CAPTION / FOOTER / UNKNOWN
layer_3_document_structure_boundary.auto_decide: partial — P7.1 can PROPOSE, Human validates

MERGE.meaning: Human judges two spans belong to same text unit
MERGE.evidence_output: ValidatedEvidence: A and B are SAME_TEXT_UNIT

KEEP_SEPARATE.meaning: Human judges two spans do NOT belong to same text unit

CANNOT_DETERMINE.meaning: Human cannot determine boundary with available evidence
CANNOT_DETERMINE.note: NOT system failure — represents genuine cognitive uncertainty

geometry_approximable.machine_resolvable_potential: yes (if geometric guard found, but needs Gate verification)

visual_context.machine_resolvable_potential: partial (line_obs>15 already DETERMINISTIC_BLOCK; line_obs<=15 needs visual context)

pure_semantic.machine_resolvable_potential: no (requires syntactic analysis, P4 contract forbids)

boundary_shrinkage.concept: 某些 ambiguity 类型从 Human 判断逐渐变为 machine 可确定性判断的过程

current_gate_status.G4: PARTIAL (P4 v3 has candidate features, irreducible FP exists)
current_gate_status.overall: NOT PASSED (2/9 gates) — no Machine Boundary Promotion allowed

body_text_continuation.reason: requires syntactic analysis (sentence boundary), P4 contract forbids text content analysis

formula_wide_low_density.reason: needs page-level visual context, P4 geometry insufficient

toc_section_number_title.reason: geometric features + text pattern may combine (needs Gate verification)

human_workload_growth.risk: document volume → ambiguous cases → human workload → system becomes human-dependent
human_workload_growth.principle: Human workload should NOT scale linearly with corpus size

strategies.boundary_shrinkage: verified ambiguity types move from Human to machine
strategies.document_type_capability: same-type documents share AMBIGUOUS pattern → verify once
strategies.human_owned_isolation: permanent Human-owned Boundary fixed, does not grow

human_workload_growth.workload_formula: Human Workload(N) = sum(mode_i) x (new_document_types + unverified_ambiguity_count) → converges to constant
